paragraphs: My name is May, and Pat is my brother. Our school has a website. It has a text about our bus. The text says, "Bus four leaves at twenty past seven." It says, "The driver waits for five minutes." We need a ticket for the bus. Mom gives us our tickets at the door. I carry the tickets in my bag.

Pat looks at the text on my tablet. "The bus comes at a quarter past eight," he says. "No," I say. "That's a mistake." "Look at the text again." Pat reads it again and laughs. "It's twenty past seven!" he says. I teach Pat the clock words. "Past is after the hour," I say. "To is before the hour."

The bus has a stop at the white house. Today we run quickly to the bus. The driver sees us and waits. The seats are blue, and the bus is clean. Pat likes the seat by the window. After school, the bus leaves at half past three. Pat says, "I can read the time now!" "Bring your ticket," I say. He holds it up with a big smile. Can you read the time on the bus text?
text.summary: May reads the bus times on the school website. Her brother Pat makes a mistake, and May teaches him the clock words.
